description: Search the General Osteopathic Council's public register by exact surname, town, postcode, practice features or registration number, or browse every practice-linked osteopath.

disabilityAccess.description: Only return osteopaths whose practice reports disabled access. Partial access counts as access, matching the register's own filter.
disabilityAccess.title: Requires disabled access

firstName.description: Optional case-insensitive contains filter applied to the first-name part of the register name.
firstName.title: First name contains

homeVisit.description: Only return osteopaths whose practice reports home visits.
homeVisit.title: Offers home visits

location.description: Exact town, county or country name, or a UK postcode/outcode such as SW1A 1AA or SW1A. Town names must match the register's own location labels.
location.title: Town, county, country or postcode

maxItems.description: Hard cap on emitted osteopath records. The full practice-linked register currently holds about 5,688 unique registrants.
maxItems.title: Maximum osteopaths

mode.description: Choose how to query the register.
enumTitles: Search by surname, location or practice features
Look up exact GOsC registration numbers
mode.title: Mode

qualificationContains.description: Optional case-insensitive text filter over the published qualifications, for example Ost or DO.
qualificationContains.title: Qualification contains

radius.description: Radius used when location is a UK postcode or outcode. Town and county searches use the register's own boundary.
radius.title: Distance from postcode

registeredAfter.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only return entries whose date of registration is on or after this date.
registeredAfter.title: Registered on or after

registeredBefore.description: Optional ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Only return entries whose date of registration is on or before this date.
registeredBefore.title: Registered on or before

registrationNumbers.description: Exact registration numbers for byRegistrationNumbers mode. Strings or integers are accepted; duplicates and leading zeros are normalised. Only the first 10,000 unique numbers are read.
registrationNumbers.title: GOsC registration numbers

status.description: Optional exact status filter applied after each register entry is read. Leave blank for every status.
status.title: Practising status

surname.description: Exact surname as held by the register, case-insensitive (for example Smith). Partial surnames such as Smit do not match. Combine with location or practice features to narrow results.
surname.title: Exact surname

welshSpoken.description: Only return osteopaths whose practice reports that Welsh is spoken.
welshSpoken.title: Welsh spoken

title: UK Osteopath Register Scraper Input
